subject: Genetics
title: STR Analysis Explained
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on STR Analysis Explained.

hook.text: Your DNA has regions where short sequences repeat: AGAT AGAT AGAT. The number of repeats is uniquely yours.

buildup.text: Short tandem repeats (STRs) vary between people. Forensic labs test 20 STR locations simultaneously.

discovery.text: Each location has a number. Together, 20 STRs create a profile with odds of one in quintillions.

twist.text: Identical twins share STR profiles. They're the one case where DNA profiling can't tell people apart.

climax.text: STR analysis replaced older methods because it's fast, sensitive, and works with degraded samples.

punchline.text: Twenty tiny DNA stutters identify you from eight billion.

quiz.question: What are STRs in DNA profiling?
